scope: Implement observed NtQuerySecurityAttributesToken using immutable captured token attributes; no guest request forwarded to a host token API. All standard attribute value types and native/WoW buffer/fault/alias contracts need native evidence or explicit primary-layout proof. No product edits yet.
acceptance: Actual pseudo-handle-4 two-name SYSAPPID/PKG query behaves like native; ordinary programs advance beyond current stop
Positive query-all and TSA://ProcUnique behavior tested; never fabricate generic empty attributes
Six-argument native/WoW transport, rights, type, capture/probe/write/ReturnLength order and failure atomicity covered
Captured data uses owned ABI-neutral values and no surviving host pointer/HANDLE; case folding follows captured Windows table without path normalization
All affected Windows/macOS/Linux configurations compile and run shared semantics, native Windows adapter/leaves execute, actual retained consumers and ordinary guests validated
Tests-only compiled baseline before implementation; all code/strategic tests before full gates; exact owned linear red publication to paired remotes

known-observations.native-query-all: one attribute TSA://ProcUnique, type2 UINT64, count2, flags0x41; native required104bytes, WoW successful88bytes
known-observations.names: case-insensitive in observed TSA spellings; duplicate request returns duplicate attributes; any missing name yields STATUS_NOT_FOUND/ReturnLength0, any empty name invalid parameter
known-observations.native-vs-wow: native length0 returns INVALID_PARAMETER without publishing ReturnLength; WoW can return NOT_FOUND0 or BUFFER_TOO_SMALL/native requirement even at length0; WoW needs native capacity104/192 before successful converted length88/160
known-observations.frontier: Both ordinary ARM64 programs stop at service0x167 with pseudo-4,count2,length816,names SYSAPPID/PKG; no guest success
